source_snapshot.procedure: Shows the sole group7/struct1 errortype2 command commented out while changing threshold FF5 to FFE.
source_snapshot.criteria: Assumes a correctable executed event without defining UCP or reset behavior.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; improperly treats the comment as executable.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Preserves the comment gate but lacks UCP, tuple, threshold and outcome authority.

old_problem: The only command is non-executable source text, UCP is undefined, and proprietary errortype2, internal target, threshold and correctable/reset disposition have no authority.
disposition_reason: A comment marker is an explicit execution boundary. Neither the CE/UCE numeric sequence nor generic MCA knowledge proves that UCP is supported, correctable or reset-producing. ED-03/11/15/16 prohibit uncommenting, acronym expansion, register guessing or inventing an alternative command. This is a true source/engineering decision and remains Pending/BLOCKED.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row71, exact AI/history2471, CE/UCE companions and next nBIF row72.
Preserved the comment marker, IOHUB UCP identity, tuple, threshold and multi-OS evidence scope.
Did not transform disabled/example syntax into executable coverage.
Required a signed command-intent decision before any severity, PASS or recovery branch can apply.
No uncommenting, threshold write, injection, reset, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: IOHUB UCP parity disposition and source-intent validation
test_case.purpose: If and only if the owner confirms an executable UCP feature, validate one authoritative stimulus at the intended IOHUB structure with the signed severity/reset outcome, exact MCA/WHEA evidence and full restoration.
required_package: Signed decision that the commented line is executable or intentionally disabled
Vendor UCP definition and errortype2 semantics
OS evidence, disposition, OOB recovery and exact restoration matrix
test_case.test_command: Keep the command commented and do not modify platform state. If the owner later authorizes it, capture raw settings and persistent logs, apply only documented masked changes, execute one verified tuple once, collect exact source/severity/outcome, then restore and compare all state.
test_case.expected_result: If unsupported, the testcase remains retained with authoritative N/A evidence rather than execution. If supported, the single stimulus matches the signed UCP source and correctable/uncorrectable/reset branch, preserves or recovers services as specified, and restores exact raw state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No executable PASS exists until command intent and UCP semantics are authoritative. Uncommenting, tool PASS from an invented command, generic parity text, wrong source/severity, unexpected reset or incomplete restoration fails.
safety_gate: Never uncomment or substitute a command without owner/vendor approval.
Dedicated SUT and OOB recovery if execution is authorized.
One target once; abort on wrong source/severity, storm, reset outside policy or instability.
No automatic retry; preserve source and platform evidence.
expected_evidence: If supported, raw before/after and single transcript
Exact MCA/APEI/WHEA outcome and service health
test_case.recovery: No execution recovery is valid until the feature and outcome are defined. The eventual runbook must restore threshold, Platform First, NBIO/FCH/HDT state and cover unexpected reset/boot failure.

source_conflict.reason: Commented command, undefined UCP and absent flag/threshold/disposition authority remain unresolved.

blocked.reason: There is no authorized executable stimulus and its unknown severity could reset or destabilize the host.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Command intent, UCP definition, vendor flag/tuple/register semantics, outcome and recovery.
pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION RETAINED; BLOCKED; NO DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: Source testcase owner, AMD IOHUB/tool owner and project RAS owner.
pending.unlock_condition: Resolve whether the feature is supported/executable and publish all semantics before revision.

project_authority: Only source owner/vendor authority may enable the commented destructive command or declare the feature unsupported.
